fields.statement: At 04706495d: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passed (TestShipChangeModelConflictFix asserts land-triage pass gate-fix-merge/fail land-conflict-triage/max_visits 4, land-conflict-triage running rhiza ship check --model-conflict with only on.pass model-conflict-fix and max_visits 4, model-conflict-fix an agent step passing only to gate-land with max_visits 3, land 4, gate-land 9, and the prompt naming rhiza set <node> --rebase and the Change/Actor/Review/Model-Conflict trailers). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-model-conflict passed: with a bare origin, fake gh and fake fixer, land is refused for the model conflict, the fixer commits one rebased update, the run returns through gate-land (visit 2), lands and merges; a refused push with no model conflict fails at land-conflict-triage with no fixer session. rhiza workflow check passed on every built-in toml and on the repo's ship-change, plan-bug and bugfix (only the expected bypass warnings).
